g.text: ArthurRank4Convo2 begins.
I'm worried about Eleanor.
She knows.
I mean, that's your job as her brother.
She can handle herself.
BRB [End.]
I know she knows, that's the damn *problem.*
Try telling that to *her.*
Sometimes, I'm not so sure.
Chat ends.
So?
I'm...not following.
Okay, brb.
I'm assuming you don't mean that literally.
She was born two minutes before me at a minute to midnight, and she thinks she's a hundred years wiser.
I just don't know how to help her anymore.
How do you help someone who can see past your words?
Oh for f-- I didn't mean that bloody literally, mate.
No, I don't mean that bloody literally, mate.
She's hurting. And she's alone. And when she's like that...she goes dark.
We've always been on the same wavelength. Twins and all.
Wouldn't that make it easier?
I can see why that'd make things harder...
And I don't mean normal dark. "Crystals and cards and ghosts" dark. I mean *pit of the void* dark.
It's one thing when you're twins and share a wavelength. It's another thing when she's literally *in* your thoughts.
When I need her to listen to reason, all she hears is *motives* and *feelings.*
Listening to your intentions rather than your words.
And you're worried someday she won't come back?
When I use Transference on Eleanor, I can hear what she hears. I don't blame her for having dark moments.
Yeah, not gonna lie, it creeps me out.
Can I make a suggestion?
I dunno, I think it's kinda hot.
How is that a bad thing?
Yikes.
Maybe that's more honest, but...complicated. Harder to convince her.
I am. I can't lose her.
I didn't even think about that...of course you can.
She can't help it. And right now, we're her only friends.
Go for it.
She can invade my mind anytime... :P
You clearly haven't spent enough time talking to her, then. It's like she's got the bloody stage directions and I don't.
Exactly. It's like she's got the bloody stage directions and I don't.
She's stronger than you give her credit for.
I'll help keep an eye on her.
Is she...okay?
She'll be fine.
Have you tried talking to her in this text app?
Have you tried telling her how hard it is to tell her how hard it is to tell her how you feel?
AUGH
Trust me, I know how proper tough she is.
+10 Chemistry
As okay as someone can be, when her friends treat her like a monster.
As okay as she can be, when her own twin brother doesn't know how to talk to her anymore.
She can hear every thought of everybody around her--and has to try to keep a straight face. I'd go dark now and again, too.
I'm not so sure. I don't think any of us can understand what she's going through.
Hard to read your mind that way. And sometimes it's easier to communicate in text. Case in point, look at us.
Okay, that sounded a lot smarter in my head.
She's my SISTER you BLOODY PSYCHOPATH
Anybody even half an ounce less capable would've snapped in half by now.
Thanks. That means a lot.
That is...very fair.
...Ouch.
Consider what Quincy thinks about when he thinks nobody's paying attention.
Chat ends.
+15 Chemistry
I admit that did make me laugh, though.
Forget I started this damn conversation!
This is a lot to adjust to--she'll be fine.
Then trust her to come to you if she needs help.
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
+10 Chemistry
I'd really rather not.
I...no. I didn't think of that.
So, good job on at least cheering me up a bit.
Chat ends.
Maybe. But this is also something she's never had to deal with before.
Hard to be the outcast amongst freaks.
Deserved, but...ouch.
But point taken.
I'm going to try that. Thank you.
And I've tried that, but it doesn't work. She just shuts me out.
And I can't stand the idea of her dealing with this on her own.
What should I do?
Update boolean ArthurEleanor
Hmm...have you tried texting her in the app?
I'd trust her to know when she needs help. She'll come to you if she does.
Some people want to deal with things on their own. Have you asked if she even *wants* help?
Have you told her *that* word for word?
Update boolean ArthurEleanor
Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurEleanor.
Sometimes it's easier to express yourself in text, anyway. Less pressure. Easier to think.
She's my sis. I can't just let her suffer. I'll think of something on my own.
Update boolean ArthurEleanor
I'd march up to her and give her a hug, personally. Let your emotions do the talking.
Talk to her on here. Hard to read minds through text.
Just...be patient. If she needs you, she'll let you know. Some people need to heal on their own.
And that's when your twin *can't* read your mind.
Chat ends.
+15 Chemistry
Might be overdue for one of those. Thanks, friend.
+10 Chemistry
Fair point. Thanks, friend.
+15 Chemistry
...No. I don't suppose as I have.
Chat ends.
Good idea. I'll try that. Thanks, mate.
Chat ends.
And...now I feel like a total knobhead.
Chat ends.
Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurEleanor.
I'll do that.
Update boolean ArthurEleanor
